name: Baidu, Inc.
fragility_flags: DATA_GAP:shares — shares missing for fiscal year(s) 2023, 2024, 2025 of the last 3 — no tier emitted
DATA_GAP:currency — filer reports in a non-USD currency (non-USD unit on revenue/NI/OCF facts in the last 3 FY); USD translations and ADS ratios are unverified — no tier emitted
STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

ADS_RATIO_MISSING: 20-F filer — per-share figures are per ordinary share but the traded price is per ADS; make_score refuses (DATA_GAP:ads_ratio) until judgment.json carries an ads_ratio {ratio, source, reason}
note: DATA_GAP: required filing data is missing (see data_gap / data_gap_uncovered). v5 never emits a tier on an uncovered data gap — a missing value is not a zero.
